# Jupyter / Zeppelin notebook git filter
# ----------------------------------------
# Add these lines to your project's .gitattributes file to prevent notebook
# outputs and execution counts from being committed to git.
#
# The nbstripout clean filter is registered automatically by the bootstrap
# script when NOTEBOOKS_ENABLED=true in .github/af-env.conf.
#
# Prerequisites (add to requirements-dev.txt):
#   nbstripout~=0.8
#
# Initial setup (first clone / new environment):
#   .github/scripts/bootstrap-python-env.ps1   (Windows)
#   .github/scripts/bootstrap-python-env.sh    (macOS/Linux)
#
# Manual registration (if bootstrap is not used):
#   .venv/Scripts/python -m nbstripout --install   (Windows)
#   .venv/bin/python    -m nbstripout --install    (macOS/Linux)
#
# Reference: https://github.com/kynan/nbstripout

# Strip outputs + execution counts on add/commit
*.ipynb filter=nbstripout
*.zpln filter=nbstripout

# Use nbstripout-aware diff display (shows source only, not output noise)
*.ipynb diff=ipynb
